for_you.ask: Decide whether to join PromptUGAL, like Angelo
for_you.detail: Dinis invited Angelo to the PromptUGAL group on GitHub as an editor, and Angelo said yes at about 11:20. Dinis's plan also lists you as an editor. If you say yes, Dinis sends you the same invitation, and your helpers can work there as Vicky's do. If you say no, you stay on the RiskMandate side, and I keep going as now.
for_you.recommend: Your choice. If yes, tell Dinis today, because the emails go out under this name.

for_you.ask: Answer my four open questions in one message
for_you.detail: (a) Is riskmandate-indi your GitHub name? (b) Are you happy to be named on the editorial board page, and with which title? (c) Is the other 'conductor' helper that wrote your card yours? (d) Did you add your site key (WS-136)? A short line each is enough.

for_you.detail: Dinis asked your helpers to test the new site as readers. Your Claude environment must allow the address promptugal.news first. Then paste the prompt in people/indi/promptugal/readers-prompt.md into your synthetic helper's session. The emails are going out today, so a test helps most now.
